svg.aria-label: Queen 2.4 end-to-end p99 against the partition count from 10 to 10,000,000 on three GCP nodes with local NVMe: at 3,000,000 msg/s of 256-byte messages 27, 17, 21, 26, 17, 21 and 29 ms; at 1,000,000 msg/s of 1 KB messages 24, 19, 17, 17, 21, 17 and 25 ms.
